mapper.insert: INSERT INTO checkout_snapshots (id, payload, expires_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{payload}::jsonb, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT payload::text FROM checkout_snapshots WHERE id = #{id} AND expires_at > NOW()

SELECT p.name, p.version AS product_version, v.version AS variant_version, v.weight_value, v.weight_unit, v.packaging_type::text AS packaging_type, c.amount_units, c.currency_code, c.amount_nanos, c.version AS price_version, c.effective_to FROM product_variants v JOIN products p ON p.id = v.product_id JOIN channel_prices c ON c.variant_id = v.id WHERE v.sku_code = #{skuCode} AND v.listing_status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.listing_status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.approval_status = 'APPROVED' AND c.channel = #{channel}::sales_channel AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.effective_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (c.effective_to IS NULL OR c.effective_to > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
